entries.title: Every integration keeps a name of its own
entries.body: A server can no longer take Google's name, even while Google is signed out, and restoring a server's original name can no longer make it share a name with another connection. A server an older version let take the name is renamed with an explanation, and Google signs in beside it. Two servers added at once always get distinct names.

picture.alt: Integrations shows Google signed in beside Google MCP server, with an explanation of the server's new name.
